3.name: Animal Speaker
3.notes: You can cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals, but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

3.name: Rage of the Wilds
3.notes:
Whenever you activate your Rage, choose one primal option:

• **Bear** — While raging, you have Resistance to all damage types except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.
• **Eagle** — When you activate your Rage, you can take the Disengage and Dash actions as part of the same Bonus Action. While raging, you can take a Bonus Action to take both actions again.
• **Wolf** — While raging, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy within 5 feet of you.

6.name: Aspect of the Wilds
6.notes:
Choose one option when you finish a Long Rest:

• **Owl** — Darkvision 60 ft. If you already have Darkvision, increase its range by 60 ft.
• **Panther** — You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
• **Salmon** — You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

10.name: Nature Speaker
10.notes: You can cast Commune with Nature, but only as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

14.name: Power of the Wilds
14.notes:
Whenever you activate your Rage, choose one option:

• **Falcon** — While raging and not wearing armor, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.
• **Lion** — Enemies within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Barbarian with this option.
• **Ram** — While raging, when you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee attack, you can knock it Prone.
